findings.reason: the plan must either make §4's cut wait on the placement or require equilibrium (and any group gaining names) to be re-audited for its new members before its release stands, or the bar of §3 is certified over a membership the released tag does not hold.
findings.text: s5 releases each further group after domains-follow-the-physics#s4 has placed transport's names by physics, but that placement moves 12 names into equilibrium (docs/plans/domains-follow-the-physics.html:107), the group §4 cuts first, and neither §4 nor s5 re-audits the first group after the placement; the first release candidate can therefore ship without the 12 members it gains, and §5's "each further group" scope does not cover it

findings.reason: without a re-read, a group's cut either refuses on a family that no longer spans or passes a family that now does, so the gate proves a membership that is no longer the group's.
findings.text: §3's family refusal reads "the ruling recorded in §2" as its exception list, and §2's per-group membership and family-spanning counts were measured on the pre-placement partition (2026-11-16/17, 225 spanning families); domains-follow-the-physics#s4 then re-domains 455 names across plasma_state, fast_particles, runaway_electrons and others, so the list the bar reads is stale for every group s5 releases, and s5 requires no re-read of §2 over the post-placement partition
